meta.title: UI Motion
meta.description: Adds a dithered signal-field backdrop to the new-session and chat pages, a blueprint headline on the new-session page, and frosted glass for the composer — every effect toggles independently under Settings → UI Motion.

runtime.title: UI Motion
runtime.lead: Toggles for motion, backdrop and frosted glass. Changes apply immediately and are stored in this browser.
runtime.masterHint: Off removes the canvas, stops animation and drops the injected styles, restoring the stock DSH look.
runtime.scopeNote: These effects only run on the new-session and chat pages; the plugin manager and the scheduled-task page keep the stock DSH look.
runtime.rowHudGlassHint: Gives the dsh-awesome-hud floating panel the same frosted glass as the composer, sharing one blur slider.
runtime.rowTitleIdleHint: Letter reveal and sweep on entry; off keeps the headline static.
runtime.rowTitleInteractHint: Glyphs turn into dashed outlines near the pointer and blocks can be dragged; off ignores the pointer.
runtime.rowBackgroundIdleHint: The noise wave drifts on its own; off freezes the field.
runtime.rowBackgroundInteractHint: Cursor erase (light) or reveal (dark) plus click ripples.
runtime.rowIntensityHint: Changes how dense the field reads, not how fast it moves.
runtime.rowBlurHint: Gaussian blur radius behind the composer.
runtime.reducedMotion: The system reduced-motion preference is on, so idle motion and pointer interaction start disabled; turn them on here if you want them.
runtime.coexist: With dsh-ascii-whales enabled as well, this plugin's composer glass and signal field take precedence.
runtime.titleUnavailable: This DSH version has no mount point for the new-session headline, so the headline effect is unavailable.
runtime.diagHint: Use this when the backdrop or headline does not show up: press Refresh and share the result.
